output.body:
h1. checkout-web runbook

Owned by team storefront (carol, dan). Alerts go to #storefront-alerts; incidents are discussed in #incidents.

h2. Known failure modes

h3. CartSerializationError
Symptom: log lines containing 'CartSerializationError: failed to serialize cart' from render_cart().
Check: error rate panel for service=checkout-web; search logs for the trace_id in the alert.
Remediation: roll back the latest deploy of checkout-web; if persists, page storefront on-call.

h3. SessionExpired
Symptom: log lines containing 'SessionExpired: session token expired mid-checkout' from submit_order().
Check: error rate panel for service=checkout-web; search logs for the trace_id in the alert.
Remediation: roll back the latest deploy of checkout-web; if persists, page storefront on-call.

h2. Dashboards
Chronosphere: rate(http_requests_total{service="checkout-web",code=~"5.."}[5m])
